name: Displace Slider
description: Full-screen WebGL slider that transitions between background photos with a displacement-map distortion while framed photo cards slide out and in with staggered motion.
contents: Full-screen WebGL background image per slide
Two framed photos per slide in the center
Numbered bullet navigation on the right edge
Scroll hint label at the bottom
behavior: Background crossfades through a generated displacement map using a three.js shader
Photos slide out upward and the next slide's photos slide in with stagger
Advances on mouse wheel and click, bullets jump to a slide
Scroll hint animates away after the first transition
editableByProps: Slides, background images and photo images
Background and text colors, font family
Distortion strength, duration, blob count, size, seed and resolution
Photo size, offset, motion distances and timings
Bullets, scroll hint and its label, wheel and click triggers

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the sequence of slide transition animations
Show more or fewer photos per slide in a different layout

fixed: Listens to window wheel events to advance slides and removes the listener on unmount
Root is full viewport height and starts invisible until the libraries load
Photo frames shrink to a 6rem minimum on small screens and are clipped by the root
